_comment: Representative DQL `fetch dt.synthetic.executions` rows (dossier §8) for ONE browser-clickpath monitor (a user-journey: open storefront -> add to cart -> checkout) across TWO probe locations. Each row carries the monitor-level outcome plus a `steps` array recording per-step detail as Dynatrace reports it -- the clickpath normalizer collapses this to ONE monitor-level health verdict per location and never models step detail in the canonical SignalObservation (dossier §5 normalization rules, AC3); the raw row is what `raw_ref` would point at archived.
